name: UltiMaker S5 0.4 nozzle
machine_start_gcode:
; NOTE: Do NOT remove the following header. It is necessary for the UM printer to not crash.
;START_OF_HEADER
;HEADER_VERSION:0.1
;FLAVOR:Griffin
;GENERATOR.NAME:OrcaSlicer
;GENERATOR.VERSION:5.11.0
;GENERATOR.BUILD_DATE:2016-06-23
;TARGET_MACHINE.NAME:[printer_model]
{if is_extruder_used[0]};EXTRUDER_TRAIN.0.INITIAL_TEMPERATURE:{first_layer_temperature[0]}
;EXTRUDER_TRAIN.0.MATERIAL.VOLUME_USED:{extruded_volume[0]}
;EXTRUDER_TRAIN.0.MATERIAL.GUID:506c9f0d-e3aa-4bd4-b2d2-23e2425b1aa9
;EXTRUDER_TRAIN.0.NOZZLE.DIAMETER:{nozzle_diameter[0]}
;EXTRUDER_TRAIN.0.NOZZLE.NAME:AA {nozzle_diameter[0]}{endif}
{if is_extruder_used[1]};EXTRUDER_TRAIN.1.INITIAL_TEMPERATURE:{first_layer_temperature[1]}
;EXTRUDER_TRAIN.1.MATERIAL.VOLUME_USED:{extruded_volume[1]}
;EXTRUDER_TRAIN.1.MATERIAL.GUID:506c9f0d-e3aa-4bd4-b2d2-23e2425b1aa9
;EXTRUDER_TRAIN.1.NOZZLE.DIAMETER:{nozzle_diameter[1]}
;EXTRUDER_TRAIN.1.NOZZLE.NAME:AA {nozzle_diameter[1]}{endif}
;BUILD_PLATE.INITIAL_TEMPERATURE:[bed_temperature_initial_layer_single]
;BUILD_VOLUME.TEMPERATURE:28
;PRINT.TIME:2
;PRINT.SIZE.MIN.X:{first_layer_print_min[0]}
;PRINT.SIZE.MIN.Y:{first_layer_print_min[1]}
;PRINT.SIZE.MIN.Z:{first_layer_height}
;PRINT.SIZE.MAX.X:{first_layer_print_max[0]}
;PRINT.SIZE.MAX.Y:{first_layer_print_max[1]}
;PRINT.SIZE.MAX.Z:{int(total_layer_count * first_layer_height)}
;END_OF_HEADER
T[initial_extruder]

M82 ;absolute extrusion mode
G92 E0
M190 S[bed_temperature_initial_layer_single] ; Wait for bed temp
M104 T[initial_extruder] S[first_layer_temperature[initial_extruder]] ; Heat extruder
M109 T[initial_extruder] S[first_layer_temperature[initial_extruder]] ; Wait for extruder temp


; Set the settings we removed in the post-processing (orcaslicer generated header).
M73 P0 R0 ;TODO change the R value into the total minutes of print
M201 X[machine_max_acceleration_x] Y[machine_max_acceleration_y] Z[machine_max_acceleration_z] E[machine_max_acceleration_e] ; accel
M203 X[machine_max_speed_x] Y[machine_max_speed_y] Z[machine_max_speed_z] E[machine_max_speed_e] ; max speed
M204 S[machine_max_acceleration_extruding] ; starting accel
M204 P[machine_max_acceleration_extruding] R[machine_max_acceleration_retracting] T[machine_max_acceleration_travel]
M205 X[machine_max_jerk_x] Y[machine_max_jerk_y] Z[machine_max_jerk_z] E[machine_max_jerk_e] ; jerk limits

M107; start with the fan off

{if is_extruder_used[0]}T0
; Prime blob for left extruder
G0 F9000 X4 Y6 Z2
G280 ; g280 is UM-specific
G1 F2700 E-6.5 ;retract{endif}

{if is_extruder_used[1]}T1
; Prime blob for right extruder
G0 F9000 X-4 Y6 Z2
G280 ; g280 is UM-specific
G1 F2700 E-6.5 ;retract
{if initial_extruder == 0}T0{endif}{endif}



M82; set extruder to absolute mode

; End of the start gcode sequence.
;LAYER_COUNT:[total_layer_count]
machine_end_gcode:
; Move toolhead out of the way
G28 X Y

M204 S3000; reset accel
M107; fan off

; heaters off
M104 S0
M104 T0 S0
M104 T1 S0
M140 S0

; disable motors
M84


M82 ;absolute extrusion mode

;End of Gcode
